capabilities: Replicate the vault in real time, two-way, against a self-hosted CouchDB server
Encrypt file contents and file names with AES-256-GCM before they leave the device
Auto-merge conflicting Markdown edits and save conflict copies for other files
Initialize devices with full upload/download and manual sync commands
Configure ignore rules, file-size limits, periodic full sync, and startup scans
extras: README warns to disable other sync methods (Obsidian Sync, iCloud, Nutstore) for the same vault and to back up first; losing the encryption passphrase makes data permanently undecryptable; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: a fully localized (Chinese UI) rewrite inspired by the design of Self-hosted LiveSync
motivation: The author rewrote Self-hosted LiveSync as a fully Chinese-localized plugin so all settings are explained in Chinese.
problem: Obsidian's official Sync is a paid cloud service, and users who self-host want encrypted sync where the server operator cannot read their notes or file names.

relations.evidence: rewrite inspired by the design of Self-hosted LiveSync (MIT License)
backed by your own CouchDB server

summary: Self-hosted vault sync to your own CouchDB server with end-to-end encryption, real-time two-way replication, and a fully Chinese interface.
